abilities.description: Fortify up to 3 hexes in Command Radius. Units in your army in Command Radius gain Harden 2 and +1 Damage until next round.

abilities.name: Unbroken Hearth
abilities.description: Until end of round, units in your army in Command Radius gain Shieldwall, Inspire, Regenerate 1, and Harden 1.

abilities.name: Undead Compact
abilities.description: Undead units in your army within Command Radius gain +2 Damage, +1 Hit, and Harden 2.

abilities.name: Vector March
abilities.description: Construct units in your army beginning activation inside Command Radius gain Open Ground (+1 Hit on Plains).

abilities.name: Void Torment
abilities.description: All enemies in Command Radius gain Fear, are Slowed, and take 2 damage.

abilities.name: Wild Hunt
abilities.description: Choose up to three Beasts in your army in Command Radius. Each may Move then make one free attack.

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.description: This company's Beast or Cavalry in Command Radius that have Charge may count Charge after moving only 1 hex this activation.

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Push an adjacent enemy 1 hex.

abilities.name: Wing Gust
abilities.description: Push an enemy adjacent to this Commander 1 hex.

abilities.name: Withering Gaze
abilities.description: Choose an enemy within 3 hexes. It gains Fear (ends at the start of the next round).

abilities.name: Wyrm Lash
abilities.description: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within 4 hexes in Command Radius.
